name: Pipeliners - Technical and Local SEO Verification 2026-09-16
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-16

# Summary
Read-only technical and local SEO verification done alongside the Sep 16 organic snapshot. Method: Python crawl of all 122 sitemap URLs plus /commercial/ and /multifamily/, a status check of all 217 internal hrefs, redirect traces, and direct fetches of third-party listings. Phone numbers were read only from static HTML, not from the GHL pool swap.

# Key findings
- Health: all 122 sitemap URLs return 200 with no redirects and self-canonicals; no sitewide indexing blocker.
- High H1: 33 of 37 city pages carry AggregateRating 4.9/122 in JSON-LD that is not visible on the page (and contradicts the visible 5.0 claims on landing pages). Fix in OTTO, not the WP database.
- High H2: /services/ has zero H1.
- High H3: /phoenix/, /avondale/, /goodyear/, /san-tan-valley/, /sun-city/, /sun-city-west/, /sun-lakes/ have a bare city-name H1.
- High H4: 122 hidden `otto-dynamic-indexing-module` links on the homepage; 60 point at 404 (21) or 301 (39) URLs.
- High H5: Birdeye and the Ace DuraFlo installer locator list (480) 969-7978 with the correct 633 W 2nd Ave address; owner must confirm.
- Medium: /free-sewer-repair-estimate/ (noindex,nofollow paid LP) in the sitemap; /pipelining/ and /free-video-inspection/ indexable without metas; no commercial or multifamily page; "Pipeliners USA" in 57 titles and 18 city H1s; moderate keyword repetition (for example "Tempe" 26 per 1,000 words); a hidden price-comparison container on the homepage; FAQPage schema on /do-gurgling-drains-indicate-a-bigger-issue/ with no visible FAQ.

# Decisions and status
- Report only. Most fixes route through OTTO (Kim) or need homepage or paid-LP approval.
- Several of these items were addressed later (see the schema accuracy and 404 audits).
